records.title: Generalized Linear Mode Connectivity for Transformers
records.reason: Conclusion and limitations discuss model alignment, interpolation barriers, and model-space geometry; no inference compute, memory, latency, throughput, quantization, or serving intervention is proposed.

records.title: MICE for CATs: Model-Internal Confidence Estimation for Calibrating Agents with Tools
records.reason: Methods, experiments, and limitations evaluate calibration and tool-calling utility; it requires access to intermediate model states and offers no inference-resource reduction.

records.title: Learning Evolving Tools for Large Language Models
records.reason: Conclusion confirms tool-variability adaptation and benchmark performance; it does not optimize model memory, compute, latency, or serving.

records.title: Analyzing and Adapting Large Language Models for Few-Shot Multilingual NLU: Are We There Yet?
records.reason: Experiments compare language-task quality and cost across adaptation setups; SIT may trade resource needs against performance, but no reusable inference-system optimization is proposed.

records.title: Routing Matters in MoE: Scaling Diffusion Transformers with Explicit Routing Guidance
records.reason: Methods and experiments target image-token expert specialization and diffusion generation quality, not language-model inference.
